node.statement: Import reduction: let P be a rank-3 exact signed idempotent (square real matrix with P^2 = P and all row sums equal to 1), let U = (u_0,u_1,u_2) be an actual-row chart whose rows p_{u_0}, p_{u_1}, p_{u_2} form a basis of the row space, define coordinates a_q(i) by p_i = sum_q a_q(i)p_{u_q} and beta_r(i) = P_{u_r i}; fix a pivot index s, a non-chart row j with c = a_s(j) > 0, a transverse index r != s, and let t be the remaining index, writing d_r = a_r(j) and d_t = a_t(j); define R_{r,j}(i) = (1/c - 1)*max(-a_s(i),0) + max(a_s(i)*d_t/c, 0) - a_s(i)*d_r/c, I_{r,j}(U) = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)*max(R_{r,j}(i),0), A_{r,s} = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)*max(a_s(i),0), and B_{r,s} = sum_i max(beta_r(i),0)*max(-a_s(i),0); then I_{r,j}(U) <= ((max(1-c,0) + max(-d_t,0) + max(d_r,0))/c)*B_{r,s} + ((max(d_t,0) + max(-d_r,0))/c)*A_{r,s}.
